Description
 You will be part of cross-functional project teams working in an Agile environment.
The primary project you will work on is built as a suite of small, independently deployable services, each running in its own process. These microservices are designed to collect and store relevant data and statistics for eBikes, and to expose processed information to other client applications.
The overall solution consists of interconnected desktop and web applications aimed at enhancing the post-purchase experience for the client’s customers. The platform provides maintenance recommendations, step-by-step service instructions, service history tracking, issue reporting, efficient firmware updates and firmware package configuration.
 Requirements
 5+ yrs. relevant experience with Automation mindset, tools & frameworks
 Good development skills in Java
 Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles
 Experience with RestAssured for API automation
 Experience with CI tools such as GitHub Actions
 Experience wit test management tools such as TestRail
 ISTQB certification is a plus
 SQL and Database knowledge
 Nice to have experience with web applications testing
 Good ability to prioritize tasks and work independently
 Good command of English
 Good communication skills
 Job responsibilities
 Develop, maintain and improve automated QA systems and associated test strategies
 Design and implement automated test cases for backend services and APIs
 Contribute to test framework enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives
 Perform API automation testing using modern tools and best practices
 Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to automation standards
 Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure product quality
 Identify, document and track defect
